Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

The current layout code supplies defaults, but this audit found no implementation or named FX suite establishing per-project/per-user persistence, reset, placeholder recovery, or inactive-perspective pop-out lifecycle. Default layout construction cannot demonstrate the required round trip. Implement the persistence boundary and the view command, then exercise E2E-18 headlessly with an unknown pane and a pop-out that hides and restores with its perspective.

Evidence:
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/layout/StudioLayouts.scala:93
- docs/studio/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:306

Remaining / next action: Implement and test all stated layout round-trip, reset, placeholder, and pop-out criteria.

Disposition: Keep open.
